headline: Meta has launched Muse Spark Open, which it calls the most capable open-weight model in the US
body: Muse Spark Open has 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window. Meta claims superior performance to other popular open-weight models, according to its evaluation results. The model is designed to run locally on Apple’s computers, and Meta is making it available through a number of API platforms.
note: Running the model locally needs a lot of power. Banks may find the open weights more useful for testing than for production.

evidence.text: Meta has launched what it calls the “most capable” open-weight model in the United States.
Dubbed Muse Spark Open, the model also has the distinction of having been designed to work with Macs.

The new model, which leverages 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, claims to offer superior performance to other popular open-weight models, according to evaluation results released by Meta on Thursday.
It has also been designed to run locally on Apple’s computers.
However, you will still need a lot of power to run the model locally, with a requirement of at least 1 terabyte of RAM, per Engadget .
Meta is making the new model available now through a number of different API platforms.
